steps.title: Prepare PDL coating solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 mg Poly‑D‑lysine hydrobromide (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat # P6407‑5MG) in 50 mL UltraPure™ DNase/RNase‑free distilled water to make the PDL solution.

steps.title: Coat coverslips with PDL
steps.instruction: Place one 18 mm #1.5 glass coverslip in each well of a 12‑well plate, add 270 µL PDL solution forming a stable meniscus, and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare culturing medium
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL T25 flask or conical tube combine: 48.5 mL Neurobasal™ Plus, 1 mL B‑27™ Plus (50×, final 1×), 500 µL GlutaMAX™ (100×, final 1×), 5 µL Gentamicin (5 µg/mL final). Equilibrate in a 37 °C CO₂ incubator overnight.

steps.title: Prepare 4 % PFA fixative
steps.instruction: Mix 1 mL of 16 % paraformaldehyde (Thermo Fisher, cat # 28906) with 3 mL PBS (pH 7.4) to obtain 4 % PFA solution.

steps.title: Prepare glyoxal fixation buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 39.45 mL 21.6 % ethyl alcohol (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat # 459836‑100ML), 1.5 mL 0.82 % glacial acetic acid (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat # 695092‑100ML), and 141.75 mL ultrapure water; titrate with 1 M NaOH (Fisher, cat # S318) to pH 5 (≈200 mL total). Immediately before fixation add 0.856 mL 40 wt % glyoxal (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat # 128465) to 10 mL of this buffer.

steps.title: Prepare blocking/permeabilization buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 5 mL 1× PBS, 5 mL fish serum (Thermo Fisher, cat # 37527), and 50 µL Triton X‑100 (0.5 % final) to a final volume of 10 mL. For surface‑only labeling omit Triton X‑100 in the blocking step and add it later during permeabilization.

steps.title: Dissect hippocampi and dissociate neurons
steps.instruction: Perform all steps under sterile conditions as described:

substeps.instruction: a. Decapitate E18 or P0–P1 C57BL/6J mouse pups, stabilize the head with thin straight forceps inserted into the eye sockets.
b. Cut skin along the sagittal suture using 3.5 mm Castroviejo scissors, then cut the skull along the same suture and the bone plate below the ears.
c. Scoop out the brain with a freer elevator or spatula and immerse it in precooled HBSS without Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ (Thermo Fisher, cat # 14170112) in a 60 mm Petri dish.
d. Using a scalpel, slice off the cortex from the midbrain.
e. Under a dissection microscope, peel off meninges with ultrafine forceps.
f. Orient each hemisphere dorsal side up, locate hippocampi, and remove them with forceps.
g. Transfer hippocampi to a 5 mL conical tube containing fresh HBSS‑/‑Ca/Mg and keep on ice.
h. Remove HBSS and rinse hippocampi twice with pre‑warmed 0.05 % trypsin‑EDTA (Thermo Fisher, cat # 25300054).
i. Incubate tissue in 5 mL fresh pre‑warmed 0.05 % trypsin‑EDTA at 37 °C for 15 min, flipping the tube once at 7.5 min.
j. Discard trypsin‑EDTA and wash tissue three times with HBSS containing Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ to quench enzymatic activity.
k. Add 1 mL pre‑equilibrated culturing medium to the tissue.
l. Triturate with a 1 mL pipette tip trimmed to three pore sizes: 11 strokes with a large‑pore tip, 11 strokes with a medium‑pore tip, and 11 strokes with an uncut tip.
m. Allow undissociated chunks to settle for 1 min, then collect the supernatant.
n. Count cells using a hemocytometer after a 5–10‑fold dilution.
o. Dilute the suspension to 360 000 cells/mL with pre‑equilibrated culturing medium.

steps.title: Plate neurons on coated coverslips
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of the 360 000 cells/mL suspension onto each PDL‑coated coverslip (meniscus must not spill), incubate ≥2 h in a CO₂ incubator for adhesion, then add 750 µL culture medium to bring the well volume to 1 mL.

steps.title: Maintain neuronal cultures
steps.instruction: Incubate plates at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for ≥14 days, refreshing 40 % of the medium every 7 days.

steps.title: Fix neurons
steps.instruction: At the desired DIV, remove culture medium, rinse twice with PBS (Thermo Fisher, cat # 10010023), then fix for 15 min with either 4 % PFA solution or the glyoxal fixation buffer. Keep cells hydrated throughout.

steps.title: Wash fixed cells
steps.instruction: Remove fixative and wash cells three times with PBS for 5 min each on an orbital shaker.

steps.title: Quench residual aldehydes
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with 1 M glycine for 15 min to quench excess aldehydes before discarding the solution down the drain.

steps.title: Block and permeabilize
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in blocking/permeabilization buffer for ≥30 min at room temperature (RT); plates may be stored in the same buffer for 1–2 days at 4 °C. Omit Triton X‑100 during blocking if only extracellular Sylite labeling is required; serum can be replaced by 3 % BSA, and blocking is optional when using Sylites alone.

steps.title: Prepare Sylite labeling solution
steps.instruction: Dilute Sylite (iSylite or eSylite) in blocking/permeabilization buffer to a final concentration of 25–100 nM (1 nM works but gives weak signal). Include any additional primary antibodies in the same solution if co‑labeling is desired.

steps.title: Incubate Sylite labeling
steps.instruction: Place 100 µL of the Sylite‑containing solution onto a Parafilm sheet in a 150 mm Petri dish, flip each coverslip cell‑side down onto the droplet, and incubate ≥30 min at RT or overnight at 4 °C (1 h at RT is recommended). Protect from strong light; for overnight incubation add a wet Kimwipe to maintain humidity.

steps.title: Wash after Sylite labeling
steps.instruction: Return coverslips to a 12‑well plate, flip them cell‑side up, and wash three times with PBS for 5 min each on an orbital shaker.

steps.title: Optional secondary antibody labeling
steps.instruction: If additional antibodies are required, apply the appropriate secondary antibodies after the Sylite wash according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Mount coverslips for imaging
steps.instruction: Place one drop of ProLong™ Gold antifade mountant on a clean microscope slide, blot excess PBS from the coverslip edge with a Kimwipe, then lay the coverslip cell‑side down onto the mountant, avoiding air bubbles.

steps.title: Cure mountant
steps.instruction: Allow the mountant to cure at room temperature for 24 h while protecting the slide from light.

steps.title: Rinse and dry mounted coverslip
steps.instruction: Rinse the coverslip surface with ultrapure water, gently blot dry to remove residual salts, then store the slide at 4 °C in the dark (stable for several weeks).

steps.title: Image samples
steps.instruction: Acquire fluorescence images using confocal, STED, or dSTORM microscopy. Note that sulfoCy5‑labeled Sylite is not photostable; use reduced laser power, line averaging, and frame accumulation. STAR635P‑labeled Sylite is photostable for confocal/STED.
